name: Google Analytics Push
description: Provides a PHP API for other modules and Rules to record Google Analytics events, dispatched either client-side (browser dataLayer push) or server-side (GA4 Measurement Protocol).

suggests.drupal/google_analytics: Falls back to its 'account' setting for the tracking ID when ga_push has none of its own.

project_description: GA Push provides an API so other modules (and Rules) can record Google Analytics events from PHP. Each event is dispatched through a pluggable 'method' registered via hook_ga_push_method. Two methods ship: 'datalayer-js' (client-side; queues the push and emits a dataLayer.push(...) into an inline script in the page head) and 'ga4mp-php' (server-side; sends a GA4 Measurement Protocol hit via the br33f/php-ga4-mp library). Supported push types include event, pageview, ecommerce, social and exception, though the two shipped methods only implement a subset (datalayer-js: event; ga4mp-php: event and ecommerce). A settings form at /admin/config/system/ga-push selects the default method and stores the GA4 measurement ID and Measurement Protocol api_secret. Version 3.0.0-alpha1 is an alpha for Drupal 10.3+/11. Initial development by GeduR; sponsored by Metadrop.
